title: layerGraph
summary: Create a layer graph compatibility object.
description: `layerGraph` creates a host metadata graph object from zero inputs or a layer collection.
behaviors: Accepts zero inputs, a layer object, a cell array of layer objects, or an object list.
Connection editing helpers such as `addLayers` and `connectLayers` remain outside this slice.
gpu_residency: Layer graph construction is host metadata work and has no provider kernel.
